headword: {悪性腫瘍|あくせいしゅよう}

definitions.explanation: A cancerous tumor that grows uncontrollably and can invade surrounding tissues or spread to other parts of the body. The medical term for cancer viewed as a physical mass.

notes:
Composed of {悪性|あくせい} (malignant, bad-natured) and ⟦{腫瘍|しゅよう}→腫瘍：23364_shuyou⟧ (tumor, swelling). In medical usage, tumors are classified as either {悪性|あくせい} (malignant) or ⟦{良性|りょうせい}→良性：22406_ryousei⟧ (benign). An {悪性腫瘍|あくせいしゅよう} is essentially what is meant by がん (cancer) in everyday speech, but the medical term is more precise and appears in diagnoses, test results, and clinical discussions.
